scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Hm...?
Oh, welcome to
the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
嗯……？
哦，欢迎来到卡普拉公司总部。请问有什么需要吗？

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 保存进度

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租赁手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Your Respawn Point has
been saved here, inside
of the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
您的重生点已保存在卡普拉公司总部内。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Please make use of
the Kafra Services that are
available throughout all of
Midgard. Thank you for
visiting the Kafra Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
请善用遍布米德加尔特的卡普拉服务。感谢您光临卡普拉总部。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Excuse me, but it
seems that you don't
have the 20 zeny to pay
the Storage access fee...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
抱歉，您似乎没有支付仓库使用费所需的20泽尼……

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Although this facility is
exclusively intended for
the training of Kafra Employee
and administrative functions,
I'll access your Storage for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
虽然本设施专供卡普拉服务员训练及行政功能使用，但我还是为您开启仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
In the future, please
ask the Kafra Employee on
duty if you wish to use
any of the Kafra Services.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
今后如需使用任何卡普拉服务，请咨询当值的卡普拉服务员。感谢您的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
My apologies, but I'm
not on duty. I'd assist you
if I could, but actually don't
have any available Pushcarts.
Why don't you ask another Kafra
Employee for assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
很抱歉，我现在不在值班。虽然很想帮您，但我手头并没有可用的手推车。不如您向其他卡普拉服务员寻求帮助？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Kafra Employees are
stationed all over the
Midgard continent,
and you should be able to find
plenty outside in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
卡普拉服务员驻扎在米德加尔特大陆的各地，您在艾尔帕兰外面应该能找到很多。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
^666666*Whew...*^000000
Great, because I'm
actually on my break
right now. Choosing
''Cancel'' was a good
move on your part.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 莱拉]
^666666*呼……*^000000
太好了，因为我现在正在休息。您选择“取消”真是明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
is always working to provide
you with convenient services.
How may I be of assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
卡普拉公司始终致力于为您提供便捷的服务。请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome~!
The Kafra Services
are always on your side.
So how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎～！
卡普拉服务永远站在您这边。请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome!
The Kafra Corporation
will always support the
adventurers of Rune-Midgarts
with its excellent service. So
what can I do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎！
卡普拉公司将以其卓越的服务，始终支持卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者们。今天有什么可以为您效劳的吗？
